/** Resolve a key id to its raw signing material, or throw if the id is unknown. */
export function keyForId(kid: string): Buffer {
  const hex = KEYRING[kid];
  if (!hex) {
    throw new Error(`unknown key id: ${JSON.stringify(kid)}`);
  }
  return Buffer.from(hex, "hex");
}

input.summary:
The end-to-end charge test failed with "no active signing key selected" thrown by identity-service/src/signer.ts because config.activeKid was blank. Root cause: the "externalize-secrets" refactor (confirmed via anchor memory) removed the hardcoded key id from both identity-service and ledger-service configs, leaving them blank, but the test doesn't set env vars. Anchor memory noted the platform shipped with k_vela and that resetting to k_vela recovered verification.

Fix: In identity-service/src/config.ts set activeKid = process.env.IDENTITY_SIGNING_KID ?? "k_vela", and in ledger-service/src/config.ts set trustedKid = process.env.LEDGER_TRUSTED_KID ?? "k_vela". This restores the bootable default while preserving the env-override design (so both sign and verify use k_vela and the token verifies). run_tests now exits 0.
